label: 初态
js: const t = document.body.innerText; return { hasCard: t.includes('先自己想一遍'), counter: (t.match(/\d+ \/ \d+/) || [])[0], total: t.includes('题库 143') };

label: 空格揭示
js: const t = document.body.innerText; return { revealed: t.includes('你答得怎么样'), hasOutline: t.includes('要点提纲'), answerLen: (document.querySelector('p.whitespace-pre-wrap')?.textContent || '').length };

label: 评会之后
js: const raw = localStorage.getItem('wkb:quiz:v1'); const s = JSON.parse(raw || '{}'); const days = s.days || {}; const slug = Object.keys(s.cards || {})[0]; return { stored: !!raw, todayCount: Object.values(days)[0], card: s.cards[slug], movedOn: document.body.innerText.includes('先自己想一遍') };

label: 评不会的排期
js: const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('wkb:quiz:v1') || '{}'); const cards = Object.values(s.cards || {}); return { cards: cards.length, levels: cards.map(c => c.level), dues: cards.map(c => c.due) };
